scenes.name: RATCHET
lines: A ratchet turns one way. In prose, an eloquent mistake can survive for decades; in Lean four, the kernel rejects it on the spot.
棘轮只朝一个方向咬合。散文里，雄辩的错误能活几十年；Lean 4 的内核当场拒收。
Every theorem added to a catalog intersects the joint kernel of indistinguishable states—blind spots can shrink, never grow.
每向目录加入一条定理，不可分辨状态对的联合核就取一次交——盲区只缩不胀。

scenes.name: NOVELTY
lines: More subtly, on a nondegenerate arena, a theorem lowers information escape if and only if it stands outside the semantic closure of what is already known.
在非退化竞技场上，定理降低信息逃逸，当且仅当它落在已有结论的语义闭包之外。
You cannot mine the same gold twice.
同一块金子，挖不了两次。

scenes.name: THE FROZEN RECORD
lines: On November 27 the independent research institute, The Omega Institute, counted 223,231 frozen Lean 4 theorems in trureturing.
独立研究机构 The Omega Institute 在 11 月 27 日的 trureturing 快照中统计到 223,231 条冻结 Lean 4 定理。
Over 81 days, 2,276 dated resolutions and two undated entries make 2,278. Of these, 1,512 were proved and 766 refuted. Quantum and physics account for 598.
81 天内有日期的题解 2,276 项，加上两项无日期记录，共 2,278 项。其中 1,512 项获证，766 项被反驳，量子与物理占 598 项。
Every one of 720 UTC hours had commits. The median was 63 commits per hour. The final seven full days averaged 217 merged pull requests a day.
连续 720 个 UTC 小时均有提交，每小时提交中位数为 63 次。最后七个完整日平均每天合入 217 个 PR。

scenes.name: PROOF AND REPLAY
lines: In November 2026, the Lean community certified Levent Alpöge’s Lean 4 proof of classical RH and Dirichlet GRH.
2026 年 11 月，Lean 社群核验了 Levent Alpöge 关于经典黎曼猜想与狄利克雷广义黎曼猜想的 Lean 4 证明。
The Omega Institute reproduced the proof in 8,490 shards. Within trureturing, the result is a separate integer Hankel equivalence.
The Omega Institute 以 8,490 个分片复现该证明。trureturing 内部另证的是一个整数 Hankel 等价判据。

scenes.name: OPEN QUESTIONS
lines: Extended RH for Dedekind zeta functions and Grand RH for automorphic L-functions remain open.
戴德金 ζ 函数的扩展黎曼猜想与自守 L 函数的大黎曼猜想仍待解决。
So do simplicity of the nontrivial zeros and their pair correlation. Each is a different question about the zeros.
非平凡零点是否均为单零点，以及它们的对关联，也各自是独立的开放问题。
